title: SREV-119 Low init protect write gate

protect_shape.description: Page protection changes are checked before local code/data writes

source_change.description: init.c fail-closed gates around NtProtectVirtualMemory writes

contracts: init.c code or data patches that request PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE through NtProtectVirtualMemory must check NTSTATUS before writing
OldProtect is initialized before each writable-protection attempt
OldProtect is restored only after the writable-protection call succeeds
WriteMemorySafe fails closed when the protection change fails
InitSyscalls skips the current syscall export when the target stub cannot be made writable
DisableCHPE returns before trampoline or target-detour byte writes when the relevant region cannot be made writable
this SREV does not change syscall selection detour bytes ARM64EC wrapper routing CHPE policy or instruction-cache flush placement
